d: America faces a wave of major disruptions as Microsoft services go down, a nationwide FAA ground stop throws thousands of flights into chaos, and banking outages hit financial giants JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America and Wells Fargo. Thousands of customers struggle to access their accounts, check balances and complete transactions, triggering fears of a wider digital crisis. With multiple critical sectors experiencing disruptions, questions mount over the vulnerability of America's technology and financial infrastructure. Are these isolated technical failures, or could something bigger be…
